ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity pixel distribution with minimal high-intensity (white) pixels on the fluke surface, indicating a contrast ratio skewed heavily toward the lower end of the grayscale spectrum.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark gray/black pigmentation covering 95%+ of the visible ventral surface. Distinct, higher-intensity dark circular spots are visible in the mid-region of the left lobe and the distal-outer region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Open V-shaped central notch with an obtuse angle estimated at 130-140 degrees; notch depth is shallow relative to the total fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge is largely smooth with low-amplitude, low-frequency irregularities; subtle serrations are detectable only at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a slightly concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a straight linear trajectory toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, circular dark pixel clusters on the mid-left lobe and the sub-terminal right lobe, consistent with remnant scarring or focal pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Increased dark pixel density and irregular texture at the vertex of the median notch and at the distal tips, suggesting minor physical wear or terminal scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Unusually uniform dark pigmentation across the entire visible ventral fluke surface, lacking the white patches typical of many regional populations.
